summary_en: This early phase I trial tests topical (applied to the scalp) or oral minoxidil to treat hair loss caused by endocrine therapy in people with stage I to IV breast cancer. Patients apply minoxidil foam to the scalp once a day, or take minoxidil by mouth once a day, for up to 12 months if the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The main outcome measure is not stated; the trial is labeled early phase I.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase temprana I evalúa minoxidil tópico (aplicado en el cuero cabelludo) u oral para tratar la caída del cabello causada por la terapia endocrina en personas con cáncer de mama en etapas I a IV. Los pacientes se aplican espuma de minoxidil en el cuero cabelludo una vez al día, o toman minoxidil por vía oral una vez al día, durante hasta 12 meses si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios no son inaceptables. La medida principal de resultado no se indica en el registro; el ensayo está clasificado como fase temprana I.
who_for: Breast cancer diagnosed at stage I to IV
Taking tamoxifen or an aromatase inhibitor, with or without ovarian function suppression
Self-reports hair loss since starting endocrine therapy
not_for: Current chemotherapy, or chemotherapy within the last 2 years
History of scarring alopecia or alopecia areata
Prior minoxidil use, or current or prior spironolactone use
Known minoxidil sensitivity, or untreated hypothyroidism or iron deficiency
